meta.title: Sending only a new end time does not extend the round
gaps: The plan cannot verify that the ending_at value was unchanged because no pre-request ending_at value is available for comparison.
The alternative behavior in which HTTP 200 applies the new end time is not covered.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Schema check: “ending at” is present.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Insufficient parameters”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Schema check: “ending at” is present.
